title.en: Bella’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Bella Swan is named in the author’s official film archive. This edition selects a personally meaningful choice in a voluntary creative afternoon. It does not measure romantic devotion, introversion, loyalty or willingness to face danger. A quiet preference can be expressed clearly and revised freely. You do not need to become mysterious, sacrifice your own plans or resemble Bella’s relationships for this limited comparison to offer something to consider.
paragraphs.zh: 作者官方电影档案列有贝拉·斯旺。本版选自愿创作下午中对自己有意义的选择，不测恋爱投入、内向、忠诚或面对危险的意愿。安静偏好可说清、可自由改；不用变神秘、牺牲计划或拥有贝拉关系，才能考虑这项有限比较。

title.en: The smaller activity may be the one you want
title.zh: 较小的活动也许正是想要的

paragraphs.en: Rain moves the group indoors, and the most impressive replacement plan does not interest you. You choose a modest part you actually want to spend time on, then explain how it could fit the afternoon. Meaning here comes from your present preference, not from proving that the group’s louder or more ambitious ideas are shallow. Other participants can find their own worthwhile choices too.
paragraphs.zh: 雨让活动入室，最厉害替代计划却没兴趣。你选真想花时间的小部分，说怎样合下午。有意义来自当下偏好，不靠证明小组更热闹、宏大点子浅；别人也可找到自己的值得。

title.en: A personal choice beside six other contributions
title.zh: 个人选择与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Edward pauses before committing, Jacob tries a practical fix and Alice plans a pleasant detail. Rosalie clarifies a chosen limit, Emmett offers gentle shared play and Carlisle asks what help is wanted. Bella’s selected angle keeps personal meaning in view. These can coexist without ranking devotion, authenticity or whose preferences deserve priority. Tied readings are several possible contributions, not competing romantic identities.
paragraphs.zh: 爱德华承诺前暂停，雅各布动手小修，爱丽丝设计愉快细节；罗莎莉说自选上限，埃美特提温和共玩，卡莱尔问需什么帮助。贝拉角度看个人意义。可共存，不评投入、真实或偏好优先；并列不是恋爱身份竞争。

title.en: Meaning can change without betrayal

paragraphs.en: A choice that mattered last month may not be what you want today. Say so without turning a preference into a permanent promise. You can enjoy the group while choosing a different part of its activity. A high count cannot establish stubbornness, dependence or exceptional loyalty, and a lower count does not mean you lack conviction, personal depth or the ability to choose for yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 上月重要的，今天也许不想。可以说，不把偏好变永久承诺。可享受小组，也选不同部分。高计数不确立固执、依赖或特别忠诚，低计数不表示没主见、没深度或不会自主选择。

title.en: Try one modest choice you can explain
title.zh: 试一个能解释的小选择

paragraphs.en: In an optional creative activity, name one small part you would genuinely enjoy and explain it in a sentence. Ask how it could coexist with others’ preferences, then decide whether the available arrangement suits you. Notice the experience rather than defending the first answer. This is feedback on one choice, not a measure of authenticity, a relationship recommendation or a reason to ignore your own needs.
paragraphs.zh: 可选创作说一项真享受的小部分，一句话解释；问怎样与别人偏好共存，再看安排适不适合。关注体验，不守首答。这反馈一次选择，不测真实，不建议关系，也不成为忽视需要的理由。

title.en: Edward’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Edward Cullen appears in the official 2008 film archive. This edition selects taking time to understand a voluntary commitment. It does not adopt surveillance, possessiveness, danger or self-denial as care, and it does not measure wisdom, anxiety or supernatural perception. A pause can lead to a yes, a no or a smaller offer. The quiz cannot identify what another person secretly thinks or whether a relationship is safe.
paragraphs.zh: 官方2008电影档案有爱德华·卡伦。本版选花时间理解自愿承诺，不把监看、占有、危险、自我否定当照顾，也不测智慧、焦虑或超自然感知。暂停可通向同意、拒绝、小些提供；不能识别人私下想法或关系是否安全。

title.en: A fast proposal does not need a fast answer

paragraphs.en: Friends replace an outdoor plan with a new indoor project and ask you to agree immediately. You ask what time, materials and responsibilities it would involve before choosing. The pause makes the decision more informed without requiring everybody to wait indefinitely. You can offer a clear time to answer or choose only the part that is already understandable and comfortable.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友把室外改室内项目，要立刻同意。你问时间、材料、责任再选。暂停让决定更明白，也不用人人无限等；可说何时答，或只接已清楚、舒服的一块。

title.en: Consideration beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Bella chooses personal meaning, Jacob tries a simple mechanism and Alice prepares an enjoyable detail. Rosalie names a limit, Emmett offers a gentle game and Carlisle asks what help would be useful. Edward’s selected angle considers what is being promised. These can support one afternoon without ranking restraint, maturity or judgement, and several high counts do not reveal a more complicated or troubled personality.
paragraphs.zh: 贝拉选个人意义，雅各布试机关，爱丽丝备细节；罗莎莉说上限，埃美特提温和游戏，卡莱尔问帮助。爱德华角度看承诺什么。可支持同一下午，不评克制、成熟或判断，多项高也不揭示复杂、困扰人格。

title.en: A pause should remain a usable choice

paragraphs.en: Decide what information would let you answer rather than reopening the decision without an end. A low-stakes hobby can tolerate uncertainty, and declining may be simpler than trying to eliminate every risk. A high count does not establish anxiety, control or superior caution, while a lower count does not mean recklessness, immaturity or an inability to consider consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 想什么信息够回答，别无终点重开决定。低风险爱好容未知，拒绝也许比消除一切风险简单。高计数不确立焦虑、控制或更谨慎，低计数不表示冒失、不成熟或不想后果。

title.en: Try a short commitment check

paragraphs.en: Before one optional project, write what you would be agreeing to and the one detail you still need. Ask for that detail, choose a reasonable point to answer and decide freely. Compare the arrangement with the actual experience afterwards. This is feedback on a decision process, not a test of judgement, a clinical indicator or permission to make choices on someone else’s behalf.
paragraphs.zh: 可选项目先写同意什么、还需哪个细节，问清、选合理答复点，再自由决定。之后比安排与实际体验。这反馈决策过程，不测判断，不是临床指标，也不授权替别人选择。

title.en: Jacob’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Jacob Black is listed in the author’s official film-cast archive. This edition selects enjoyable practical tinkering in a harmless hobby. It does not infer ethnicity, cultural identity, physical strength, aggression or relationship suitability. A fictional character is not evidence about real Quileute people or traditions. You can choose a small repair because it is fun without being assigned a permanent helper role or a claim of technical expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 作者官方电影名单有雅各布·布莱克。本版选无害爱好里的愉快动手，不推族裔、文化身份、体力、攻击或关系适配。虚构人物不是现实Quileute人群、传统的证据。小修可纯为好玩，不永久派帮手，也不声称技术专业。

title.en: A little adjustment can teach the group enough
title.zh: 一点调整也能给足发现

paragraphs.en: A homemade craft prop almost works but one ordinary connection is loose. You ask what the maker wants changed and try a simple adjustment. Watching the mechanism respond is part of the enjoyment. There is no need to turn the object into a professional project, use hazardous tools or keep repairing after the agreed small change is complete.
paragraphs.zh: 自制手作道具快能用，普通接点松了。你问制作者想改什么，试简单调整；看回应就是乐趣。不必变职业项目、用危险工具，或约定小改完仍继续修。

title.en: Tinkering beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Bella keeps personal meaning visible, Edward considers the promise and Alice adds a pleasant detail. Rosalie clarifies the limit, Emmett brings gentle shared play and Carlisle asks what help is welcome. Jacob’s selected angle tests a practical arrangement. These can coexist without ranking usefulness, strength, gender or professional skill. A tied result is not a competition between romantic partners or fictional supernatural groups.
paragraphs.zh: 贝拉留个人意义，爱德华想承诺，爱丽丝加细节；罗莎莉说上限，埃美特温和共玩，卡莱尔问欢迎何种帮助。雅各布角度试实际组合。可共存，不评用处、力量、性别或专业；并列不是恋爱伙伴、超自然群体竞争。

title.en: A fix is still something you choose

paragraphs.en: Ask before changing another person’s object, and agree what finished means. You can enjoy a failed attempt and decide not to continue. Knowing how to adjust one harmless mechanism does not obligate you to repair everything around you. A high count cannot establish technical talent, impulsivity or masculinity, and a lower count does not imply helplessness or a lack of practical interest.
paragraphs.zh: 动物件前问，约完成条件。失败尝试也可好玩，也可不续；会调一机关，不等于义务修所有。高计数不确立技术天分、冲动或男性气质，低计数不表示无助、没实际兴趣。

title.en: Try one permitted, low-stakes adjustment
title.zh: 试一次经同意、低风险调整

paragraphs.en: Choose an ordinary paper or craft mechanism that is safe to handle, ask its owner about one small change and try only that change. Observe what happens and stop at the agreed point. Use a demonstration or description instead if hands-on work is not suitable. This gives feedback on a hobby attempt, not a vocational aptitude score, a physical ability judgement or evidence about cultural identity.
paragraphs.zh: 选能安全用的普通纸、手作机关，问主人一项小改，只试这项；看结果，到约定点停。不适合动手可演示、描述。这反馈爱好尝试，不是职业潜能分、身体判断或文化身份的证据。

paragraphs.en: Alice Cullen belongs to the film ensemble named in the official archive. This edition selects preparing a few enjoyable details for a voluntary gathering. It does not measure prediction, intuition, shopping, sociability or how accurately you can read somebody’s wishes. A pleasant plan should use preferences people actually share, with room to change it. No result grants knowledge of another person’s future or authority to organise their life.
paragraphs.zh: 官方档案电影群像有爱丽丝·卡伦。本版选给自愿聚会准备愉快细节，不测预测、直觉、购物、社交或猜愿望多准。好计划应按实际分享偏好，也容修改；结果不赋知道未来或安排别人生活的权力。

title.en: A changed afternoon can still feel prepared
title.zh: 改变的下午仍可有准备感

paragraphs.en: Rain removes the original outdoor occasion, so you choose a few small indoor details that the willing participants would enjoy. A handwritten opening card or a little reveal may be enough. The point is to make this modest version feel considered, not to replace a cancelled event with more work or surprise someone who has already said that they prefer a simple afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 雨取消原室外活动，你选愿意参与者会喜欢的几项室内细节。手写开场卡、小揭幕也许够；是让小版本有用心，不是补更多工作，也不惊喜已说想简单的人。

title.en: Preparation beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Bella chooses personal meaning, Edward checks the commitment and Jacob tries a practical fix. Rosalie names a limit, Emmett adds gentle play and Carlisle asks what support is wanted. Alice’s selected angle prepares a pleasant touch. These can coexist without ranking thoughtfulness, optimism or how much effort a host should make. Several high counts do not reveal a special predictive or social gift.
paragraphs.zh: 贝拉选意义，爱德华核承诺，雅各布试小修；罗莎莉说上限，埃美特加温和游戏，卡莱尔问支持。爱丽丝角度备愉快点缀。可共存，不评用心、乐观或招待者该做多少；多项高不揭示预测、社交天赋。

title.en: A surprise needs room for preference

paragraphs.en: Ask whether the person likes surprises and keep a clear way to decline or simplify the plan. A carefully prepared detail is not a debt the recipient must repay with delight. You can enjoy planning without taking over. A high count cannot establish excessive optimism, compulsive planning or exceptional intuition, and a lower count does not mean thoughtlessness or a lack of care for others.
paragraphs.zh: 问喜不喜欢惊喜，留拒绝、简化办法。用心细节不是收者必须用欣喜偿还的债。可享受计划，不接管。高计数不确立过度乐观、强迫计划或特别直觉，低计数不表示不用心、不在意人。

title.en: Try one detail people have welcomed
title.zh: 试一项别人欢迎的细节

paragraphs.en: For a small optional gathering, ask about one preference and prepare one modest detail around the answer. Make it easy to change and notice whether it adds enjoyment without creating unwanted work. Afterwards, ask rather than assume how it felt. This is feedback on an event detail, not evidence about foresight, empathy, relationship compatibility or a person’s obligation to make every occasion special.
paragraphs.zh: 可选小聚问一偏好，按回答备一小细节，让它易改；看是否加乐趣、不添不想接的工作。之后问感受，不臆测。这反馈活动细节，不证明先见、共情、恋爱适配，也不要求每次都特别。

title.en: A smaller role is still a contribution

paragraphs.en: The group assumes that you will handle every decorative detail because you enjoyed one part last time. You say which part you want to do now and where it ends. This lets others plan around an actual offer rather than a guess. You may keep the enjoyable piece, decline the rest and still participate in the afternoon without proving a reason everybody considers sufficient.

title.en: A chosen limit beside six other contributions
title.zh: 自选上限与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Bella keeps personal meaning visible, Edward considers the promise and Jacob tries a simple adjustment. Alice prepares delight, Emmett offers gentle play and Carlisle asks what help is wanted. Rosalie’s selected angle clarifies the limits of the offer. These can support one activity without ranking independence, self-respect or generosity, and a tied result does not reveal an internal battle between caring and protecting yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 贝拉留意义，爱德华想承诺，雅各布试调整；爱丽丝备愉快，埃美特温和玩，卡莱尔问帮助。罗莎莉角度说提供的上限。可支持同一活动，不评独立、自尊、慷慨，并列不揭示照顾与自保的内在战斗。

title.en: A limit does not need a performance

paragraphs.en: Say what you choose in language that fits the situation. You do not need to sound tough or give every private reason. A limit can change when you freely want to offer more, and it can remain in place when somebody is disappointed. A high count does not establish hostility or guardedness, while a lower count does not prove weak boundaries, self-neglect or an inability to say no.
paragraphs.zh: 用适合场景的话说选择，不用显强硬、交代所有私因。自愿想多给时可改上限；别人失望时也可留。高计数不确立敌意、防备，低计数不证明界限弱、忽视自己或不会拒绝。

title.en: Try one offer with a clear ending
title.zh: 试一个有明确终点的提供

paragraphs.en: For an optional hobby task, write what you want to contribute and a clear stopping point. Tell the group before beginning, then check whether the arrangement remained voluntary in practice. Revise the offer next time if needed. This is feedback on one agreement, not a measure of strength, a judgement about a relationship or advice to distrust people who ask for help.
paragraphs.zh: 可选爱好任务写愿贡献什么、明确停点，开始前告诉小组；之后核实际是否仍自愿，下次可改。这反馈约定，不测强弱，不评关系，也不建议不信求助的人。

It does not measure physical strength, risk-taking, masculinity, confidence or a character’s ability to fight. A small challenge can be seated, verbal, visual or simply watched. Enjoyment does not require loudness, competitive success or pretending that everybody has the same energy.

title.en: A little game after the work is done

paragraphs.en: Friends finish their handmade pieces and want to mark the moment. You offer a lighthearted challenge whose rules are simple and whose result stays inside the game. Watching or declining is equally welcome. The shared laugh comes from enjoying the activity, not from making someone’s mistake, ability or reluctance into entertainment for the rest of the group.
paragraphs.zh: 手作品完工，朋友想留一刻。你提规则简单、输赢留在游戏内的轻松挑战，旁观、拒绝同样欢迎。共同笑来自活动，不拿人失误、能力或不愿意当其他人娱乐。

title.en: Play beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Bella chooses meaning, Edward considers the commitment and Jacob enjoys a practical fix. Alice prepares a pleasant detail, Rosalie states a limit and Carlisle asks about useful support. Emmett’s selected angle adds gentle shared play. These can coexist without ranking fun, bravery or how much energy someone brings. A close or tied count does not establish who is the group’s entertainer or strongest member.
paragraphs.zh: 贝拉选意义，爱德华想承诺，雅各布乐于小修；爱丽丝备细节，罗莎莉说上限，卡莱尔问支持。埃美特角度加温和共玩。可共存，不评有趣、勇敢、精力；近分并列不指定谁是娱乐者或最强成员。

title.en: The audience can choose too

paragraphs.en: Check whether the game is wanted before starting it, and let people participate in different ways. A quiet ending may suit the group better than another activity. You do not owe a cheerful performance when you are tired. A high count cannot establish recklessness, dominance or constant optimism, and a lower count does not mean humourlessness, physical weakness or an inability to enjoy company.
paragraphs.zh: 先问想不想玩，再开始，也容不同参与。安静收尾可能更合适；累了不用欠开心表演。高计数不确立冒失、支配或总乐观，低计数不表示无幽默、体弱或不能享受陪伴。

title.en: Try a game with a watching role
title.zh: 试一个有旁观角色的游戏

paragraphs.en: Choose a harmless, low-stakes group game with simple rules and an easy opt-out. Offer an enjoyable way to watch or comment, then ask whether anyone wants to play before beginning. Stop while the activity is still welcome. This gives feedback on one invitation to play, not an assessment of sociability, athletic ability or whether you should become responsible for everyone’s good mood.
paragraphs.zh: 选无害低风险、规则简单、易退出的群体游戏，给好玩旁观、评论方式；开前问愿不愿。仍受欢迎时收。这反馈玩乐邀请，不评社交、运动，也不让你负责所有人好心情。

title.en: Carlisle’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Carlisle Cullen appears in the official film-cast archive. This edition selects discussing help that both people freely choose in a voluntary activity. It does not measure medical judgement, ethics, empathy, parenting or self-sacrifice. A kind offer may be accepted, changed or declined. The result cannot show that you know another person’s needs better than they do or that you should provide professional care.
paragraphs.zh: 官方电影名单有卡莱尔·卡伦。本版选自愿活动中聊双方自选的帮助，不测医学判断、伦理、共情、育儿或牺牲。友好提供可接受、改、拒；不能显示比本人更懂其需要，也不建议提供专业照顾。

title.en: Ask before supplying the solution

paragraphs.en: A friend is uncertain about the changed indoor plan. You ask what would be useful instead of assigning them a need. They might want a practical option, time to think, a smaller role or simply to watch. You can say what you can comfortably offer too. The arrangement becomes helpful through an actual agreement, not because one person has correctly guessed everything about the other.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友犹豫室内新计划。你问什么有用，不先派需要。也许要实际选项、时间、小角色或只看；你也可说舒服能提供什么。帮助来自实际约定，不靠一人猜全另一人。

title.en: Support beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Bella chooses personal meaning, Edward pauses before promising and Jacob tries a small fix. Alice prepares delight, Rosalie names a limit and Emmett offers gentle play. Carlisle’s selected angle asks which support is wanted. These can coexist without ranking compassion, goodness or who should look after the group. A tied reading is not evidence that you have a hidden caring profession or a duty to rescue anyone.
paragraphs.zh: 贝拉选意义，爱德华承诺前停，雅各布试小修；爱丽丝备愉快，罗莎莉说上限，埃美特温和玩。卡莱尔角度问需要何种支持。可共存，不评同情、好坏或谁该照顾群体；并列不揭示照护职业、救人义务。

title.en: Care includes the person offering it

paragraphs.en: Keep the offer within what you genuinely want and can provide. Respecting a no can be more useful than insisting on help, and asking directly is clearer than assuming a special insight. A high count does not establish moral superiority, exceptional empathy or a need to rescue others, while a lower count does not mean selfishness or an inability to care about friends.
paragraphs.zh: 提供留在真愿意、能给的范围。尊重拒绝可比坚持帮助有用，直接问比假设特别洞察清楚。高计数不确立道德更高、共情特别或救人需要，低计数不表示自私、不能在意朋友。

title.en: Try an offer both people can revise
title.zh: 试一个双方都能修改的提供

paragraphs.en: In a small optional task, ask what help is wanted and describe one thing you are willing to offer. Make acceptance, revision and refusal equally clear, then compare the actual experience with the agreement. Stop or change the arrangement if either person wants to. This is feedback on ordinary cooperation, not a clinical, ethical or professional care assessment and not a rule about what friendship requires.
paragraphs.zh: 小型可选任务问想要什么帮助，再说一件愿给的事，讲清接受、修改、拒绝都可，再比体验与约定。任一人想停、改都能做。这反馈普通合作，不评临床、伦理、专业照护，也不规定友情要求。

title.en: Twenty-one choices and every highest tie

paragraphs.en: Complete all 21 situations. Every explicitly mapped choice adds one raw count to one of seven characters, making 21 counts in total. Each character is offered 12 times, three times in each option position; an absent character is not rejected. All highest counts receive complete guides. All A produces three counts each and a seven-way tie. These are choices within this bank, not match percentages, norms, relationship compatibility, clinical findings or validated personality differences.
paragraphs.zh: 完成21情境，每项明确映射选择给七人物中一位加一次原始次数，总计21次。每人物出现12次、每位置3次；没出现者不算被拒绝。所有最高获全文；全选A各3次，七方并列。只描述本题本，不是匹配百分比、常模、恋爱适配、临床发现或经验证人格差异。

title.en: Original fan edition and source limits
title.zh: 原创同人版与来源边界

paragraphs.en: FermatMind independently authored this unofficial fan edition: original questions, mappings, examples and complete readings. Stephenie Meyer’s public 2008 film-cast archive supports basic names and the film ensemble only; it does not validate these editorial angles or this bank. Names belong to their respective rights holders. No film images, dialogue, novel passages, competitor items or reports are reproduced. This is entertainment without official affiliation or scientific validation, and it does not infer romance, diagnosis, ethnicity, danger, professional ability or supernatural power.
paragraphs.zh: 费马独立创作本非官方同人版的题目、映射、例子与全文。Stephenie Meyer公开2008电影名单档案只支持基本名称、电影群像，不验证本版编辑角度、题本。名称属于各权利方，不复用剧照、台词、小说段落、竞品题目或报告。本版娱乐，无官方合作、科学验证，不推断恋爱、诊断、族裔、危险、职业能力或超能力。
